description: 河川監視カメラ位置情報データ [dams, reservoirs and flood defences] is a dataset listed in Tokyo Metropolitan Government Open Data Catalog Site (catalog.data.metro.tokyo.lg.jp), an open data portal, published or maintained by 東京都建設局. 【東京都建設局】建設局では、水防活動や迅速な避難行動につながる河川の状況をわかりやすく確実に提供するため、河川監視カメラを設置しています。 カメラより得られた映像は、東京都水防災総合情報システム（ kasen-suibo. metro. tokyo. lg. jp/im/uryosuii/tsim0102g. ht... Coverage: Tokyo, Japan. The portal files it under the publisher 東京都建設局. Its tags are デジタルツイン. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-12-12 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is クリエイティブ・コモンズ 表示（CC BY）. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-tokyo-portal.
